quotation: Our experiments show that this serializable mode provides performance similar to snapshot isolation and considerably outperforms strict two-phase locking on read-intensive workloads

sentence.text: Dan Ports and Kevin Grittner, writing about the implementation that appeared in PostgreSQL 9.1, report from their experiments: “Our experiments show that this serializable mode provides performance similar to snapshot isolation and considerably outperforms strict two-phase locking on read-intensive workloads”.
